# Web Style Atlas entry

Resolve the atlas root before reading relative paths. Prefer an explicitly supplied
WEB_STYLE_ATLAS_ROOT local checkout. Validate its package.json name is
web-style-atlas and that START_HERE.md, core/skill/SKILL.md and catalog/index.json
exist. Otherwise use a validated atlas ancestor of this skill file. Never assume
the target project's working directory is the atlas.

If this wrapper was copied into a different project, supply the separate atlas
checkout root. If no local checkout is accessible, use the explicit source
https://github.com/lmatukas/web-style-atlas, resolve its observed revision and read
files at that revision using the host's available read tools. If neither route is
available, request the source files; do not invent their contents.

Read core/skill/SKILL.md from the resolved atlas root and follow it. Resolve links
inside that canonical file against its original atlas location, never this wrapper
or the target project's current directory. Keep the target project's existing
